Know what is behind the numbers

Method & assumptions

Monthly reducing-balance annuity with nominal annual interest divided by 12. Rates stay constant in each scenario. No daily accrual, deposit offsets, staged drawdowns or automatic insurance financing. Payments shown are rounded, calculations use unrounded values.

HKMA currently publishes a general maximum 70% LTV, 50% DSR limit and 30-year mortgage term. Higher LTV under MIP is conditional. These are planning references, not a lending decision.

Privacy

This version has no advertising or analytics scripts, contact forms or browser storage. Calculator inputs are held only in this tab and are not sent by this application. Hosting providers may process ordinary request logs. A summary is saved to your device only when you download it. External links have their own policies.

About this project

HK Mortgage Explorer is an early planning tool for Hong Kong homebuyers and mortgage holders. It does not arrange loans or provide bank approval. This preview contains illustrative scenarios. Advertising is planned, but AdSense is not active.

Independent planning estimates. Confirm terms, eligibility and costs with the bank before acting.
